static_traits.name: 李文浩
static_traits.educational_background: 美术类大专在读/Partial university education（美术）
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友，可进行日常交流，但not yet分享其深层的Loneliness与自我憎恨感受
static_traits.medical_history: 此前without类似心理问题求助；No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度较好，能描述负性自动思维；逻辑性尚可，情绪基调消极（自责与despair）；能接受“记录自动思维”的建议；语速与语气not yet特do not提及

basic_info.main_problem: 对当前生活深感not满，尤其对“自己已是年纪较大却仍not yet结婚”这一事实反复思考，由此产生自我憎恨与despair感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些自我憎恨和not满严重影响我的心理健康和整体生活享受，希望通过咨询改善。
growth_experiences: 曾有几段亲密关系但not yet能维持，这些经历被来访者用来证明自己“难以被爱”，加深了对Single与自我价值的负性关联。
长期受到社会对年龄与婚姻的期待影响（将“not yet在某年龄结婚”视作失败），逐渐Introjection为个人评判标准，形成“Unmarried=失败/有问题”的信念。

special_situations.event: 晚上Being alone时更频繁出现负性想法
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果到了这个年纪还have not结婚，就说明我有问题、是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用园艺和艺术来分散注意力，但not yet能持续缓解情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我注定会Loneliness一辈子；我有问题；I am not worthy of being loved

special_situations.event: 看到朋友或家人在幸福关系中时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人都有伴侣而我have not，就证明我not如人、我失败了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces in-depth communication and hides real feelings to avoid being compared and evaluated

special_situations.event: 回想过去几段not yet能维持的关系
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果过去关系都失败，说明我本质上难以被爱、以后也not会有not同
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自责与事后假设（如果当时我做得not同就not会这样）
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是not被爱；我的not yet来也会一样糟

special_situations.event: 获得朋友的欣赏或艺术方面的正面反馈时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非拥有伴侣关系，否则其他被欣赏与认可都“not算数”
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极信息、继续Reinforcement“Single=失败”的标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些认可not重要，have not伴侣才说明我有价值

core_conflict.wish: 渴望稳定亲密的伴侣关系与被爱、被接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被评判为失败者、害怕长期Loneliness与自我价值被negate
defense_goal: 通过隐藏脆弱与not向他人求助来避免Being rejected或羞耻
以自我贬低和降低期待来减少再次受挫的恐惧

object_relations.object_representation: 他人（潜在伴侣/社会）是评判者与拒绝者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被问及是否向朋友或身边人表达真实的Loneliness与自我憎恨时，或面临需要暴露脆弱的时刻
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If exposing vulnerability leads to being looked down on or rejected, therefore feelings must be suppressed
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Glosses over sensitive topics briefly and vaguely, returning to neutral descriptions; restrained tone, avoiding expressing strong emotions and personal needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在看到他人处于幸福关系或回想自己关系失败时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把失败和问题完全归咎于自己，认为“It is all my fault”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与标签化用语（如“我就是not行”），语气低落，重复“如果当时我做得not同就好了”。

manifestations: 长期Single，将“Unmarried=失败”内化为自我评判标准
晚上Being alone时负性思维加剧，反复出现“注定Loneliness”的想法
与朋友维持表面交流，not yet分享深层Loneliness与自我憎恨
outcomes: 艺术创作受损，日常作息被打乱

manifestations: Internalizes society's expectations about age and marriage into the rigid rule 'I should be married at this age'
以“Unmarried=失败/有问题”评价自我，忽略个人处境与多元价值

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对其他人或物做出某个行为的冲动，转而对自己做，将对外能量Turning against the self。
manifestations: 在需要寻求支持或表达脆弱时转而自责，not向朋友分享真实感受
Replaces contact with others and help-seeking with self-criticism, maintaining isolation

仍保持一定的朋友支持网络（虽not yet分享深层感受）
Has self-awareness and proactively seeks help, willing to try recording automatic thoughts and conducting reality testing

回避披露与寻求支持，导致支持系统not yet被激活，Loneliness被维持
Excessive self-blame and self-labeling, forming a negative self-concept and reducing action motivation
Sleep and diet disturbance，进一步削弱情绪调节与日常功能

target_behavior.behavior: 夜间Being alone时的反刍自责与自我贬低
antecedent: 看到他人处于幸福关系
回想过去关系失败的经历

target_behavior.function: Avoids facing more complex grief and longing, gains a temporary sense of control and cognitive consistency through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与despair加重，Sleep and diet disturbance，艺术创作与日常功能受损

target_behavior.behavior: 回避披露真实感受与寻求支持
